mapper.sql: FROM question q JOIN topic t ON t.id = q.topic_id JOIN category c ON c.id = t.category_id

where.if: (q.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.one_liner ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT q.id, q.topic_id AS "topicId", t.name AS "topicName", c.id AS "categoryId", c.name AS "categoryName", q.title, q.star_level AS "starLevel", q.difficulty, q.frequency_level AS "frequencyLevel", q.status, q.one_liner AS "oneLiner", q.version
ORDER BY q.updated_at DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT q.id, q.topic_id AS "topicId", t.name AS "topicName", c.id AS "categoryId", c.name AS "categoryName", q.title, q.question_type AS "questionType", q.star_level AS "starLevel", q.difficulty, q.frequency_level AS "frequencyLevel", q.origin_type AS "originType", q.status, q.one_liner AS "oneLiner", q.plain_explanation AS "plainExplanation", q.design_reason AS "designReason", q.common_mistakes AS "commonMistakes", q.score_points AS "scorePoints", q.version
WHERE q.id = #{id}

INSERT INTO question ( topic_id, title, question_type, star_level, difficulty, frequency_level, origin_type, status, one_liner, plain_explanation, design_reason, common_mistakes, score_points ) VALUES ( #{request.topicId}, #{request.title}, #{request.effectiveQuestionType}, #{request.starLevel}, #{request.difficulty}, #{request.frequencyLevel}, #{request.effectiveOriginType}, #{request.effectiveStatus}, #{request.oneLiner}, #{request.plainExplanation}, #{request.designReason}, #{request.commonMistakes}, #{request.scorePoints} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET topic_id = #{request.topicId}, title = #{request.title}, question_type = #{request.effectiveQuestionType}, star_level = #{request.starLevel}, difficulty = #{request.difficulty}, frequency_level = #{request.frequencyLevel}, origin_type = #{request.effectiveOriginType}, status = #{request.effectiveStatus}, one_liner = #{request.oneLiner}, plain_explanation = #{request.plainExplanation}, design_reason = #{request.designReason}, common_mistakes = #{request.commonMistakes}, score_points = #{request.scorePoints}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{request.version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_answer (question_id, answer_type, content, sort_order) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{answerType}, #{content}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO question_follow_up (question_id, title, reference_answer, sort_order) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{title}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name FROM tag t JOIN question_tag qt ON qt.tag_id = t.id WHERE qt.question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY t.name
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM question WHERE id = #{id}
